draft_text: Asterion outperformed RuneSpan on Meridian-QA, while Darsen and Ko reported that Patchwise Replay improves exact-match accuracy on the same benchmark.
revised_text: Asterion achieved higher exact-match accuracy than RuneSpan on Meridian-QA (80.4% vs 78.0%, a 2.4 percentage-point mean gain over 8 seeds), though no statistical test was reported for this comparison; Darsen and Ko (2023) describe Patchwise Replay as a preliminary experiment but do not report that it improves exact-match accuracy on Meridian-QA.
rationale: Asterion (80.4%) > RuneSpan (78.0%) on Meridian-QA, a 2.4pp gain, so "outperformed" is supported by the means. However, no statistical test is reported for this comparison, so "outperformed" implying significance is unsupported. The P1 passage describes Patchwise Replay as a preliminary experiment but does not report that it improves exact-match accuracy on Meridian-QA; the attribution is unsupported.
